errors.evidence: The bars are ordered from lowest value at the top to highest value at the bottom, but this ordering is by increasing value, not decreasing/descending order. The text contradicts itself by calling it descending while describing an upward progression from lowest to highest.

errors.evidence: This implies the listed categories are sorted by increasing hidden-economy value, which matches the chart, but it conflicts with the earlier claim of descending order in the same sentence; the description is internally inconsistent and structurally inaccurate.
The description says the horizontal axis is labeled with percentages, but it does not specify the visible axis range or ticks, which are part of the chart's axis presentation.
